overview.description: Janus Henderson International Core Alpha ETF is an actively managed exchange-traded fund that seeks long-term capital appreciation by investing primarily in equity securities of companies located outside the United States. The fund uses fundamental research to identify high-quality international companies with attractive valuations and the potential for sustainable earnings growth, investing across developed and emerging markets.
